fields.summary: Board View – Deleted Lead Technician's Work Order Shows Under "Unknown Technician"
Board View — board by lead technician

issuetype.description: Stories track functionality or features expressed as user goals.
issuetype.name: Story

fields.description:
h2. Overview

When a technician who leads a work order is deleted in *Settings → Staff*, the work order stays assigned on *Board View*, but under a column headed *"Unknown Technician"* with a generic person icon. The technician's name is lost, so nobody can tell whose work it was.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Create a new test user, activate the user, and give them the *Technician* system role.
# Go to *Work Orders* → *All* → *Board View*.
# Drag a work order onto the new user's column to make them its lead technician.
# Go to *Settings* → *Staff*, click the *pencil icon* on the new user, click *Delete* and confirm the deletion.
# Go back to *Work Orders* → *All* → *Board View*.

h2. Observed Outcome

The work order (S1-3 in the screenshot) still shows as assigned, but in a column headed *"Unknown Technician"* with a generic person icon. The deleted technician's name is not shown, and the column has no inactive marker.

h2. Expected Outcome

The spec covers a *deactivated* technician but does not say what happens when the technician is *deleted*. For a deactivated technician it says:

* *S3-N2:* "Keep matching work visible in its deactivated technician’s column."
* *S3-N4:* "Show an inactive indicator on deactivated technician columns."
* Decision (2026-09-13): "Deactivating a technician does not change work orders they already lead. They remain the lead technician on those work orders so the work stays visible and attributable; they simply receive no new assignments."

A column named "Unknown Technician" keeps the work visible but not attributable. *PO to confirm* the expected behaviour for a deleted technician (for example: show the technician's name with the inactive marker, as for a deactivated technician, or move the work order to Unassigned).

h2. Evidence

!SV_unknown_technician.png|width=1000,alt="SV_unknown_technician.png"!

h2. Source

* Spec: [Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/~7120207b6068952672480db1a06bd810e23ba1/pages/845185030/Work+Orders+Board+View+Tech+View+Display+Options] (read 16 Oct 2026), Story 3 (Board View) S3-N2 and S3-N4, and the Decisions entry of 2026-09-13 on deactivated technicians. Tech View has the matching rules S2-N2 and S2-N3.
* Story SV-10046 (Board View — board by lead technician).

h2. Notes

* Found on Staging (app.staging.shopview.com) by QA (Bilal Muzamil); the screenshot is from that run.
* The spec says nothing about deleted technicians, so the expected result needs the PO's decision.
* Tech View may show the same "Unknown Technician" group; not checked in this pass.

----

*Test case for this issue:*

* [C614711|https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/614711] Work orders of a deleted lead sit under Deleted technician, which takes no drops

comments.body:
[~accountid:712020:aa00b8d6-a71f-4259-8919-82a304227c20] a decision for this one. The PRD covers a deactivated lead (S2-N2/S3-N2, S3-N4, decision 2026-09-13) but not a deleted one.

*What happens today:* Delete in Settings → Staff removes the staff record and the user account permanently, so the technician's name no longer exists anywhere. Their work orders keep the deleted person as lead. Board View and Tech View show them under "Unknown technician", with no name, no inactive marker, and a drag grip. Nothing can be dropped onto that column. The List shows the lead as blank. Showing the name with the inactive marker, as for a deactivated technician, isn't possible for anyone already deleted.

*Options:*

# *Unassigned.* When a technician is deleted, their work orders lose the lead and move to Unassigned, and the existing cases are cleaned up once. Who led the work is lost.
# *An honest column.* Keep the column, but label it "Deleted technician", show the inactive marker, and remove the grip. The List stays blank. This is the smallest change.
# *Prevent it.* Don't allow deleting a staff member who leads work orders or has logged labor; offer Deactivate instead. This keeps the name and the work attributable, and stops time records from losing their technician. It's outside this feature, so it would be its own ticket.

Our suggestion: 2 in this release, plus 3 as a separate ticket.

*Related, same family:* a lead whose Time Clock is turned off (not deleted) keeps their own column or group, with their name, while they have work. Nothing can be dropped onto it, and with no work they have no column. That matches the build, but the PRD only spells this out for a technician not enrolled at the location (S3-R20b/c). OK to write the same rule down for a lead with Time Clock off?

[~accountid:712020:1b27a800-7b5a-43f3-982a-81e7071a4fdb] option 2 in this release, plus 3 as its own ticket. [PRD v59|https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=845185030]:

# S3-R20e: work orders whose lead was deleted sit in one column (Board View) / group (Tech View) labeled "Deleted technician", with the inactive marker and no drag grip. Drag out only, nothing dropped in. List stays blank as today.
# S3-R20d: yes, a lead with Time Clock off keeps a named column or group while they lead work, nothing can be dropped onto it, and it goes once they lead none, the same as S3-R20c. That matches the build.
# Preventing the delete (offer Deactivate when the person leads work or has logged labor) is SV-11427, outside this feature.

[~accountid:712020:6d590212-5c9b-4135-ae11-277f3826110e] [~accountid:712020:aa00b8d6-a71f-4259-8919-82a304227c20] the fix follows PRD v59 S3-R20e (Chris, comment above):

* Work orders whose lead was deleted sit in one "Deleted technician" column on Board View, and one group in Tech View, with the inactive marker and no drag grip.
* Work orders can be dragged out of it; nothing can be dropped in.
* The List still shows Lead Technician blank.

C614711 was written against v58: step 11's "every column header names whose column it is" and "same name as the Lead Technician from step 9" won't hold under S3-R20e. Could you update the case, and the ticket's Expected Outcome, to S3-R20e? The fix ships in the follow-up PR to #3730, not in #3730 itself.
